    text = f.read()

orig = text

text = text.replace(
    'across two models (Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B).',
    'across four code-specialized models spanning 1.5B--13B parameters and three architecture families (Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B, Qwen-2.5-Coder-1.5B, DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B, and CodeLlama-13B).'
)

# 2. Key finding sentence
text = text.replace(
    r'Our key finding is that exception events alone achieve 99.83\%/99.33\% accuracy across models (cross-model gap = 0.50pp), while a multi-component representation (VOTA) degrades by 14.96pp on the weaker model.',
    r'Our key finding is that exception events alone achieve $\geq$99.33\% accuracy on all four models regardless of scale, while the no-trace baseline exhibits strict scale monotonicity (67.31\%--76.50\%), demonstrating that information quality dominates model scale for verdict prediction.'
)

    'that transfers across model families without requiring deep trace reasoning.',
    'that transfers across model families and scales without requiring deep trace reasoning.'
